overview_description.description: PLAN0 AI provides an AI-powered preconstruction cost intelligence platform for the commercial real estate and construction sectors. The software uses computer vision to analyze architectural drawings and generate detailed cost takeoffs, 3D models, and standardized budget estimates in minutes. It combines these outputs with a localized database of historical and real-time project cost data to deliver trade-level pricing forecasts up to 24 months out. The platform supports automated cost estimation, real time data and predictive analytics, and scenario simulation for different design options and materials. Real estate developers, general contractors, and investors use PLAN0 AI to evaluate design alternatives, verify pro-forma assumptions, stress-test budgets against cost overrun patterns, and forecast construction costs. The product is delivered as cloud-based software with workflows that start from plan upload and end with cost forecasts and scenario analysis outputs.
